name: Sam Quinn
biography: Sam Quinn is a Senior Security Researcher on the Advanced Research Center Vulnerability team, focused on finding new vulnerabilities in both software and hardware. Sam has a focus on embedded devices with knowledge in the fields of reverse engineering and exploitation. He has had numerous vulnerability findings, published CVEs in IOT and enterprise software, and has spoken at multiple industry conferences such as Def Con, BlackHat, North Sec, and Hardwear.io.
